verdict.rationale: LibreChat is documented as a self-hosted web app that you install with Docker, npm, or Helm on your own machine or Kubernetes cluster, so you decide where the instance and its data live. The docs never describe data residency, region selection, or storage-location controls as such, so residency is only implied by the deployment model. missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region documentation, guidance on where conversation/file data is stored, independent corroboration of residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Install LibreChat yourself with Docker, npm, or a Helm chart. It is a self-hosted web app, not a desktop installer.
Docker and npm run it on your own machine on Windows, macOS, or Linux and serve it at http://localhost:3080
Please follow this guidance to deploy LibreChat on Kubernetes using Helm
